vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: worthclip-youtube-video-scorer
Version: 1.0.4

The skill bundle is classified as suspicious due to critical input sanitization vulnerabilities in its shell scripts. Specifically, `scripts/feed.sh` is vulnerable to shell injection, as user-supplied arguments are directly concatenated into the URL query parameters without proper escaping, allowing arbitrary command execution. Additionally, `scripts/score.sh` has a JSON injection vulnerability where the `VIDEO_ID` is directly embedded into a JSON payload, potentially allowing manipulation of the request body. While there is no evidence of intentional malicious behavior (e.g., data exfiltration to unauthorized domains or persistence mechanisms), these vulnerabilities pose a significant security risk, allowing an attacker to potentially compromise the system executing the skill.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements (curl, jq, WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) and scripts are consistent with a YouTube scoring integration, but the API base URL (greedy-mallard-11.convex.site) does not match the stated WorthClip homepage (worthclip.com), which is unexpected and should be verified before use.

dimensions.detail: The skill name, description, required binaries (curl, jq), and single env var (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) align with a small API-backed YouTube scoring integration. However, the SKILL.md declares the API Base URL as https://greedy-mallard-11.convex.site/api/v1 which does not match the declared homepage (https://worthclip.com) or the expected official API host. This domain mismatch is unexplained and suspicious.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped: run the included bash scripts (score.sh, feed.sh, usage.sh) which submit jobs, poll, and retrieve feed/usage. The SKILL.md only references the WORTHCLIP_API_KEY and the service endpoints; it does not ask the agent to read local secrets or unrelated files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only plus shipped scripts). That minimizes installer risk—nothing will be downloaded or written by an installer. The provided scripts will execute via bash and rely on curl/jq already on the system.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one credential is required: WORTHCLIP_API_KEY (declared as primary). This is proportionate for an API client. Confirm the key's scope/permissions before use (read-only vs billing/modify).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Model invocation is disabled (disable-model-invocation: true) and 'always' is not set. The skill cannot be autonomously invoked by the model and does not request permanent presence—this reduces privilege concerns.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, inspect the included scripts (scripts/score.sh, scripts/feed.sh, scripts/usage.sh) to confirm they only call the documented API endpoints and do not send your API key or other data to unexpected hosts. Verify the correct WorthClip API hostname from official WorthClip developer docs—the SKILL.md's base URL (greedy-mallard-11.convex.site) mismatches the declared homepage and could indicate a staging or third-party proxy. If you proceed, use a revocable/test API key with limited permissions, and consider contacting WorthClip support to confirm this deployment URL is legitimate. If you can't verify the API host, avoid supplying your real API key.
